name: penge-passport-ph-monorepo
description: PengePassportPH: the Node.js and Python packages, the website, and the alert server.

scripts.canary: npm run build -w penge-passport-ph && node scripts/canary/api.mjs; a=$?; uv run --project packages/python python scripts/canary/python.py; p=$?; node scripts/canary/ui.mjs; u=$?; exit $((a || p || u))
scripts.canary:api: npm run build -w penge-passport-ph && node scripts/canary/api.mjs
scripts.canary:ui: npm run build -w penge-passport-ph && node scripts/canary/ui.mjs
